adoption_note: The original criterion (train/validation gap must not increase) failed: 6.68 pp vs 9.35 pp. It was judged badly specified because it penalizes a better training fit even when validation improves. The tuned model was adopted under a new criterion fixed before the check: the worst recursive WMAPE on 2024 over seeds 0-4 of the tuned model (25.16%) is better than the best of the conservative model (26.78%).
